question: Among female patients born between 1970 and 1990 who were admitted to the hospital, identify those with either abnormal red blood cell counts or elevated LDH levels. Then, determine how many of these patients also have uric acid levels above the female normal threshold. Additionally, exclude any patients whose laboratory records are from before 1995.

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.XCL_058)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.XCL_058 = e.XCL_001
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
WHERE p.XCL_059 = 'F'
  AND p.XCL_060 BETWEEN '1970-01-01' AND '1990-12-31'
  AND e.XCL_013 > 0
  AND l.XCL_015 >= '1995-01-01'
  AND (
    (l.XCL_019 < 100 OR l.XCL_019 > 400)
    OR l.XCL_018 > 500
  )
  AND l.XCL_022 > 6.5

FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.XCL_058 = e.XCL_001

  )
  AND l.XCL_022 > 6.5
